source_refs.note: 'Model Robustness and Reliability' under topic 6.8, as printed (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: Robustness means a model performs well in different situations. A reliable model gives consistent results. Robust models handle noise in data. They do not fail easily with small changes. Reliability is important for real-world use. Testing under different conditions checks robustness. Strong models maintain accuracy. Reliability builds trust in systems. Robust models are more useful.
